category: documented speedrun seed / structured observations / supplied landmarks
description: Documented Java 1.16.1 set-seed speedrun world. Start with an empty inventory, defeat the Ender Dragon, then enter the exit portal. Peaceful difficulty: no hostile mobs spawn, so blaze rods and Ender Pearls cannot be obtained. The stronghold's End portal has one naturally active portal block (supplied landmark); filling frames is not required.

landmarks.name: Ruined portal beside the village (incomplete obsidian frame, loot chest)
